summary.text: R. Scott Campbell, a Democrat from St. Johnsbury, has represented Caledonia-Essex in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2019.
He is vice chair of the House Committee on Energy and Digital Infrastructure.

paragraphs.text: Campbell was born in Maryland and has lived in St. Johnsbury since 2005, according to his House biography.
His background is in construction, building design and energy modeling, and he received a BA in Government from Cornell University.
He was founding director of Capstone Community Action's 3E Thermal, directed CVOEO's Weatherization Program, and owned a small design-build contracting firm.
Since the summer of 2023 he has worked on developing the Caledonia Food Co-op.
He is past board president of Catamount Arts and a past board member of Rural Edge.
